# TokenLedger — AI API Token & Cloud Cost Simulator

> Free, live AI API token counter and monthly cost simulator comparing 22 leading models across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, xAI, Qwen, Mistral, and Groq with prompt caching and batch API discounts.

## Main Resources
- [Live AI API Cost Simulator](https://tokenledger-six.vercel.app/): Paste prompts, pick workload presets, and calculate monthly bills across 22 models.
- [XML Sitemap](https://tokenledger-six.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Full index of all 231 model-to-model cost comparison pages.
